subject.title: fix(xai): respect ssrfPolicy and request.allowPrivateNetwork in image_generate

question: Should xAI image generation inherit both browser.ssrfPolicy private-network authorization and the full models.providers.xai.request transport override block?
rationale: The code is consistent with the shared request-policy seam and the analogous OpenAI behavior, but it intentionally expands a private-network authorization boundary and activates existing auth/proxy/TLS settings on a previously unaffected image path.

options.title: Approve shared policy scope
options.body: Keep both opt-in routes and full configured-request handling, contingent on current-head production-path proof of default denial and explicit success.

options.title: Limit to provider request opt-in
options.body: Remove the browser-level authorization from xAI image generation and allow private access only through models.providers.xai.request.allowPrivateNetwork.

options.title: Pause for shared SSRF redesign
options.body: Do not merge until media-provider private-origin trust and global SSRF authorization are defined through a narrower shared contract.

recommendation.title: Approve shared policy scope
recommendation.body: Keep both opt-in routes and full configured-request handling, contingent on current-head production-path proof of default denial and explicit success.
